title: SRRM: A Retrieval-Reconstruction Benchmark for Evaluating Long-Context Memory in Small Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.05386v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Small Language Models (SLMs) are increasingly deployed on consumer-grade hardware, yet their ability to preserve information across progressively longer contexts remains insufficiently understood. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate retrieval-oriented tasks, providing limited insight into whether successful retrieval reflects comprehensive long-context memory preservation. To address this limitation, this paper introduces Simple Retrieval-Reconstruction Memory (SRRM), a lightweight and fully reproducible benchmark that jointly evaluates Targeted Retrieval and Global Information Reconstruction. This study also proposes the Memory Preservation Ratio (MPR), a benchmark-level metric that quantifies the relationship between retrieval and reconstruction performance. SRRM was evaluated using a synthetic dataset on three Qwen2.5 models (0.5B, 1.5B, and 3B parameters) across context loads ranging from 10 to 100 factual statements. Experimental

translated_title: SRRM：一个用于评估小语言模型长上下文记忆的检索-重构基准
translated_abstract: 小语言模型（SLM）越来越多地被部署在消费级硬件上，但它们在日益增长的上下文长度中保留信息的能力仍缺乏充分的理解。现有基准主要评估面向检索的任务，对于成功的检索是否能反映全面的长上下文记忆保留，仅能提供有限的洞察。为解决这一局限，本文提出了简单检索-重构记忆（SRRM），这是一个轻量级且完全可复现的基准，可联合评估定向检索和全局信息重构能力。本研究还提出了记忆保留率（MPR），这是一个基准层面的指标，用于量化检索与重构性能之间的关系。SRRM使用合成数据集在三个Qwen2.5模型（0.5B、1.5B和3B参数）上进行了评估，上下文负载范围涵盖10到100条事实陈述。
tldr: 该论文提出了轻量级可复现的SRRM基准和记忆保留率（MPR）指标，通过联合评估定向检索与全局信息重构能力，来衡量小语言模型的长上下文记忆保留水平。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SRRM, a lightweight and fully reproducible benchmark that jointly evaluates targeted retrieval and global information reconstruction, along with the Memory Preservation Ratio (MPR) metric, to quantify long-context memory preservation in small language models.
